= title-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-05
:value: expanded

== Name

title-subs - independent title substitutions

== Synopsis

.S01 Quote *title* {value} (C)
[quote,Writer,Work,subs="none"]
S01 body *bold* {value} (C).

.S02 Verse _title_ {value} (R)
[verse,Poet,Work,subs="none"]
S02 first _italic_ {value} (R).
S02 second.

.S03 Ordinary title (TM)
[subs="-replacements"]
S03 body (TM).

.S04 Listing title (C) <tag> & text
[listing,subs="none"]
S04 body (C).

.S05 Literal title (R)
[literal,subs="none"]
S05 body (R).

.S06 Source title (TM)
[source,text,subs="none"]
----
S06 body (TM).
----

.S07 Title (C) with literal pass:[(R)] and \(TM)
[subs="attributes"]
S07 body {value} (C) *bold*.

.S08 Title (R)
[subs="replacements,specialchars"]
S08 body (C) *bold*.

.S09 Abstract title (C)
[abstract,subs="none"]
S09 body (C).

.S10 Disclosure title (R)
[example%collapsible,subs="none"]
S10 body (R).

[cols="1a"]
|===
|.S11 Cell title (C)
[quote,subs="none"]
S11 body (C).

|.S12 Cell title (R)
[verse,subs="none"]
S12 first (R).
S12 second.
|===

+

[subs="none"]
S13 body (C).

.S14 Outer title (C)
--

[subs="none"]
S15 body (R).

[subs="none"]

[subs="none"]
